summary:
TerraProof helps farmers and agricultural advisers understand their land and explore what to plant next. It brings soil information and NASA weather data into one easy-to-use tool, turning complex information into clear explanations. Farmers can find their land on a map, explore crop options and compare planting plans based on soil conditions, past weather and planting schedules.
Farmers can also compare their usual crop sequence with alternatives, check possible timing conflicts and understand differences in water needs. A downloadable summary makes it easier to discuss options with an agricultural adviser. TerraProof supports informed planning, while local knowledge and soil tests remain essential before making planting decisions.
details:
TerraProof helps farmers and agricultural advisers understand their land and explore what to plant next. Users select their land on an interactive globe, review soil information and past weather, and compare their usual crop sequence with alternatives. The app explains planting schedules, possible timing conflicts and differences in crop water needs in everyday language. Farmers can download a readable comparison to discuss with a local adviser. Its intended impact is to make agricultural information easier to access and help farmers ask better questions before changing their planting plans.

We developed TerraProof using Python and FastAPI for data processing, React and TypeScript for the interface, and Cesium for the interactive globe. It uses NASA POWER weather data, NASA Earth imagery and optional NASA future-climate simulations, alongside ISRIC soil information and FAO crop references. Its creative approach connects land exploration, soil information and crop planning in one guided experience. We considered ease of use, mobile access, water availability, planting dates, missing information and the limits of regional estimates. TerraProof supports planning discussions; it does not guarantee harvest results or replace local expertise and soil testing.
